about.subtitle: Talk To Paste · v{{version}}
about.description: TTP is a free, open-source app I built because I got tired of typing. Press your hotkey, talk, your words land in whatever you're using. Groq does the transcription. An optional polish pass trims the 'uhms'.
about.author: Built by Amir KELLOU--SIDHOUM. If you find it useful, feel free to share it or connect with me!
about.privacyBody: TTP collects none of your data. Your API key is stored locally on your machine. Audio is sent directly from your device to Groq's servers for transcription. I never see, store, or have access to any of it. Same for AI Polish: your text goes straight to Groq, not through me. Everything stays between you and your API provider.

pro.title: Support TTP
pro.descFree: TTP is free and complete — every feature, no limits, no subscription. If it saves you time and you feel like sending something back, a one-off licence is a way to do that. It unlocks nothing; you already have everything.
pro.deactivateHelp: Deactivating frees an activation slot so you can use this license on another device.

companion.faceDesc: The pill blinks when idle, keeps still while it works, and marks the moment your words land. Subtle by default, and it never asks you for anything.

default.name: House
default.desc: The two polite tones TTP was born with.

bowl.name: Bowl
bowl.desc: A small brass bowl. The stop is someone's hand on it.

marimba.name: Marimba
marimba.desc: Two notes on a wooden bar. Up to begin, down to finish.

submarine.name: Submarine
submarine.desc: A sonar ping into the quiet. Something down there heard it.

felt.name: Felt
felt.desc: A piano with a blanket over it. Barely a sound at all.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.desc: A drop going in, and a drop coming back out.

recordingTrigger.title: Shortcut
recordingTrigger.desc: Hold to record, release to stop. Double-tap to toggle hands-free mode.
recordingTrigger.fnEmojiTitle: The 🌐 key opens the emoji picker
recordingTrigger.fnEmojiDesc: macOS pops the emoji picker every time you press Fn. Set the 🌐 key to "Do Nothing" so Fn just records. Your shortcut keeps working.

recordingMode.title: Behavior
recordingMode.handsFreeDesc: Press once to start, press again to stop.
recordingMode.hidePillDesc: Only show the recording indicator while you're recording.
recordingMode.vadAutoStopDesc: End the recording automatically once you've stopped speaking. Useful when you forget to release the hotkey.
recordingMode.audioDeviceDesc: Pick the microphone to record from. Falls back to the system default if the device is unplugged.
recordingMode.launchStartupDesc: Open TTP automatically when you log in.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.polishDesc: Trim filler words and fix grammar with AI.
transcription.languageDesc: Pin Whisper to a specific language. Defaults to Auto (Whisper detects per recording). Pin to English or French if Whisper occasionally hears the wrong language.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.helpDesc: Send anonymous crash reports to Sentry.
privacy.whatSentBody: Crash reports only (error type, OS, app version, pipeline stage). No usage analytics are collected.
privacy.neverSentBody: Your transcription text, API keys, file paths, or any personal data.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.emptyState: Type a misheard word above and the correction TTP should use instead.

history.title: History
history.saveDesc: When off, new transcriptions aren't saved to history.
history.emptyEnabled: Your transcriptions will show up here.
history.emptyDisabled: Turn on "Save transcriptions" to keep a history.
history.replayTooltip: Type this entry into the focused app

analytics.title: Your usage
analytics.desc: Local stats from your transcription history. Nothing leaves your machine.
analytics.empty: Numbers show up after your first dictation.

updateChannel.title: Release track
updateChannel.descBeta: You test new releases before public launch.
updateChannel.descStable: You only get stable, reliable releases.
updateChannel.warning: Beta builds may contain bugs. You can switch back to stable at any time.

logs.title: Diagnostics
logs.desc: Open the folders containing ttp.log, ttp-trace.log and any retained recordings so you can attach them to a bug report.

diagnostics.label: Record transcription text in the trace
diagnostics.desc: ttp-trace.log always records every dictation stage — timings, filter verdicts, whether the keystrokes actually landed. Turn this on to also record the text itself at each stage, which is what you need to see exactly which stage dropped a dictation. Your transcriptions are then stored in plain text on this Mac.

reset.title: Reset
reset.desc: Reset all settings to defaults and clear the dictionary.

uninstall.title: Uninstall TTP
uninstall.desc: Remove the app and every trace of your data: settings, history, dictionary, license, Keychain credentials, and macOS permissions.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Pick the language used across TTP. Affects every window and the tray menu.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.desc: Use light, dark, or follow your macOS system setting.

help.microphone: Required to capture your voice for transcription.
help.accessibility: Lets TTP paste the transcription into your active app. Without it, text only lands in the clipboard (Cmd+V to paste).
help.inputMonitoring: Lets TTP detect when you press the Fn / Globe key for push-to-talk. Without it, only the keyboard-shortcut mode works.
help.apikey: Groq's free tier covers tens of thousands of transcriptions per month. You won't see a bill from typical usage.

trial.perkPolish: Unlimited AI Polish on every transcription
trial.perkHistory: Full history of every transcription, searchable

wizard.welcomeBullet1: Hold a hotkey and talk. TTP transcribes and pastes into the active app.
wizard.welcomeBullet2: Lives in the menu bar. No window to manage, no dock icon.
wizard.welcomeBullet3: Your voice goes to Groq for transcription. Nothing else leaves your Mac.

wizard.preferencesSubtitle: Set the basics now. All of these live in Settings if you change your mind later.
wizard.tourSubtitle: Three things to know before you go. Take ten seconds.

preferences.hidePillLabel: Hide the pill when you're not recording
preferences.hidePillDesc: The floating indicator stays out of sight until you press your shortcut.
preferences.autostartDesc: Wakes up with your Mac so the shortcut is ready when you are.
preferences.telemetryDesc: Only crash signals. Never your transcripts.

tour.step1Body: Press and hold. Speak. Release. TTP records while the key is down.

tour.step3Body: TTP lives in the menu bar at the top of your screen. You can also search "TTP" in Spotlight (⌘Space).
